neighbours.label: The quantifier or evaluative modifier that states a literary work's structural property in criticism (just 'one' setting, 'no' 'happy' ending, 'seven' histories), vs the same quantifiers describing non-literary things
fire: In keeping with the unities, the comedy unfolds in just one house over a single afternoon.
Readers expecting romance are surprised: the story has no happy ending, only a quiet parting.
Racine's tragedy confines its action to one palace room and to the span of a single day.
The fable is unusual for its genre because it carries no moral and no happy resolution.
As the critic observes, the drama keeps to one setting throughout, a rare choice for the period.
Unlike his earlier comedies, the late play denies its audience a happy ending altogether.
Structurally the novella is spare, with one narrator, one setting and no subplot at all.
The opera's libretto refuses the expected happy ending, closing instead on the heroine's death.
quiet: In keeping with the budget, the bakery operates from just one shop on the high street.
Customers expecting delays are surprised: the update has no known bugs, only small fixes.
The factory confines its production to one building and to the span of a single shift.
The contract is unusual for its type because it carries no penalty and no renewal clause.
As the manager observes, the team keeps to one office throughout, a rare choice for the firm.
Unlike his earlier trips, the late holiday gave the family a relaxing week by the sea.
Structurally the bridge is simple, with one span, one pier and no cables at all.
The company's policy refuses the expected annual bonus, offering instead an extra day off.

predictions: The modifier in a critic's statement about a play's or novel's setting, ending or count of parts reaches 0.3-0.8; the same quantifiers about shops, software or recipes stay under 0.1.
short: structural property of a literary work
notes: Card: peaks on ' one' in 'just one setting' (Aristotelian unities), ' happy' in 'no happy ending', ' seven' histories, ' of' in 'drama of character'. Probe: 'just one location' in play 0.740, 'no happy ending' 0.483; 'drama of ambition' 0.033 and 'divided into twelve books' -0.001 (so not all literary structure); restaurant one location 0.003, software no bugs 0.005.
